title: Tryouts and Mixtape
author: Yara Montrose
blurb: Coral Zhou, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, has spent ten years being so careful it hurts. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before prom.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
